page_title: Item:Legendary Medium Armor of the Crownblade

enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.

Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +15 (Exceptional bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.

Linguistics: This item reduced the cooldowns of your Social skills (Diplomacy, Bluff, Intimidate) by 15%. This does not stack with the Negotiator ability.
